phrase: the chemistry laboratory stereotypically uses various forms of laboratory glassware . however glassware is not central to chemistry, and a great deal of experimental chemistry is done without it. solutions of substances in reagent bottles, including ammonium hydroxide and nitric acid , illuminated in different colors a chemical reaction is a transformation of some substances into one or more different substances. 19 the basis of such a chemical transformation is the rearrangement of electrons in the chemical bonds between atoms.
